name: Magog
overview: Magog is identified in Scripture as a son of Japheth, listed among his descendants in Genesis 10:2. The prophetic books, particularly Ezekiel 38 and 39, depict Magog as a land and people associated with Gog, who oppose God and His people, highlighting their role as enemies of the Lord. Revelation 20:8 further portrays Gog and Magog symbolically as forces deceiving the nations and gathering for a final battle against God’s kingdom, emphasizing their ultimate defeat and the sovereignty of the Lord.
